hooks.name: uak-start
hooks.command: git -c "alias.uak-hook=!unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_PREFIX GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS; exec bash .uak/bin/hook session-start gemini" uak-hook

hooks.name: uak-guard
hooks.command: git -c "alias.uak-hook=!unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_PREFIX GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS; exec bash .uak/bin/guard bash" uak-hook

hooks.name: uak-output-cap
hooks.command: git -c "alias.uak-hook=!unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_PREFIX GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS; exec bash .uak/bin/hook wrap gemini" uak-hook

hooks.name: uak-tick
hooks.command: git -c "alias.uak-hook=!unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_PREFIX GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS; exec bash .uak/bin/hook tick gemini" uak-hook

hooks.name: uak-away
hooks.command: git -c "alias.uak-hook=!unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_PREFIX GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS; exec bash .uak/bin/hook session-end" uak-hook

args: alias.uak-mcp=!for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' 2>/dev/null && exec "$p" .uak/bin/uak-mcp; done; echo 'uak-mcp needs Python 3.8+ (the uak CLI works without it)' >&2; exit 1
